parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and durability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Upper Door)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, typically covering the freezer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the freezer section and provides insulation to maintain low temperatures.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Lower Door)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, typically covering the main cooling compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the refrigerator section and helps maintain internal temperature by sealing tightly when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Other (Dispenser Area)
parts.Basic_description: This is the dispenser area of the refrigerator, made of durable plastic, located on the front of one of the doors.
parts.Functional_description: It dispenses water or ice and includes control buttons or levers for user interaction.
parts.Movement_description: It includes small movable components like levers or buttons but is mostly fixed to the door.
